Clickable. On the desktop board: Library / Dictionary in the nav, New article, and clicking an article row all work.

In the reader, the 語彙解説 switch turns word explanations on and off. Marked words carry a dashed underline — hover one to see its card.

Still open, not guessed:

1. Which words get marked (the hard-vocab rule is undecided).
2. Where sentence Q&A lives — the right rail here is a proposal, not a decision.
3. "Last read" needs a new column; nothing records it today.
